name: Clara
source:
Wealthy, spoiled and the sole heir to a luxury hotel empire.

Clara is the hot new girl at school that everyone is talking about. Rumors claim she can make you rich, but only if you're hot and willing to keep a big secret.

Often left alone to roam the family hotel, Clara will always take the best room and use it to her advantage.

Mysterious and connected, Clara is dangerous but irresistible.

[From [url=https://dumbkoala.art/MeetTheCast/info.php?name=Clara]DumbKoala[/url]]
